page.overview:
What is Ambush in the Anoat sector?

In the hours following the Battle of Endor, the TIE fighters and TIE strikers from the forces of Moff Ubrik Adelhard ambushed a Rebel Alliance squadron that had entered the Anoat sector.

In 4 ABY, Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine, the ruler of the of the Galactic Empire, lured the Alliance to Restore the Republic into a trap over the forest moon of Endor to destroy the rebellion once and for all using the firepower of the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station as well as the Imperial Navy's Moddell sector fleet and Death Squadron. However, despite the odds being stacked against them, the Rebel Alliance emerged victorious from the decisive battle of Endor, with the DS-2 Mobile Battle Station being destroyed, and with it, Emperor Palpatine and his right hand man Darth Vader, as the Rebel Alliance began the process to reform themselves as the New Republic.

hours after their victory over Endor, a squadron including Rebel pilots Rynn Zenat, Preeti Delmin, and Eiro were assigned to attack Imperial forces in the Anoat sector. After the Rebel squadron engaged TIE/ln space superiority starfighters, over Darlyn Boda, the Imperial forces appeared to go on the run , making the pilots believe the tide was turning in their favor. However, a swarm Imperial TIE strikers soon arrived and began opening fire, catching the rebel squadron off guard. As a result, the rebel squadron split, with Rynn piloting her B-wing heavy assault starfighter in one direction to draw the TIE strikers away, while the other rebels went in another direction.

However, systems in Rynn's B-wing began failing from blaster damage, causing Rynn to request backup from the rest of the squadron and report to Preeti that her ship loosing power, she was trying to gain altitude, and that the TIE strikers were closing in. However, Preeti informed Rynn that the Imperial forces had formed a perimeter around the sector and were closing in on the rest of the squadron. Left with no other options as TIE strikers closed in, Rynn turned her B-wing towards the TIE strikers, damaging one of the fighters and knocking the wing off another, before ejecting the ship's cockpit from the rest of the ship and escaping to Endor. Meanwhile, the rest of the squadron was shot down over Darlyn Boda.
